messages:
julia: Dropped a tiny proposal/demo for Go SDK resume ergonomics. TL;DR: add a ResumePolicy enum and a small Attach helper so callers don't accidentally reuse short-lived ctxs and to make resume semantics explicit. Thoughts?
pete: link?
julia: https://git.redwood/internal/sampleapps/gosdk-resume-policy. Core rationale: too many users reuse request-scoped ctxs for Resume and hit immediate ErrDeadlineExceeded. Also we currently conflate server-driven detaches with io.EOF which prevents proper handling.
eva: I like the enum idea. What values are you proposing?
julia: Proposal: ResumePolicy{Strict, AutoAttach, BestEffort}. Defaults to AutoAttach. Semantics: 
- Strict: Resume(ctx) uses caller ctx only; fail fast on expired ctx.
- AutoAttach: SDK creates a bounded internal handshake ctx (configurable HandshakeTimeout) and attempts a single attach; returns ErrStreamDetached if server indicates detach.
- BestEffort: like AutoAttach but performs a small retry/backoff on transient 502/503 for up to HandshakeTimeout.

Snippet in the demo: 
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(cfg)
opts := client.Generators.Options{
  ResumePolicy: client.Generators.ResumePolicyAutoAttach,
  HandshakeTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
}
gen := client.Generators.New(opts)
// consumer uses gen.Stream() normally; on detach the SDK will auto-attach per policy
```

pete: two immediate questions: (1) AutoAttach hiding the handshake might surprise callers who expect Resume to respect their ctx deadlines, (2) BestEffort retrying could hide auth issues.
julia: fair. That's why Strict exists for power users. AutoAttach is targeted at quickstarts and onboarding where ergonomics matter. BestEffort can be opt-in and is useful for flaky infra during rollout. We should document behavior clearly.
eva: also add ErrStreamDetached sentinel and keep io.EOF for normal completion. And provide Stream.DetachMeta() with server reason codes (auth_rotate, node_restart) to help apps decide to backoff or surface to user.
pete: server-side must support idempotent resume: accept (session_id, cursor, resume_key) and return 200 if compatible, 409 for replay conflict. SDK maps 409->ErrReplayConflict. Without that we'll still see duplicates.
julia: yep, demo includes a small repro that shows duplicate chunks when server isn't idempotent and how resume_key prevents it.
ci-bot: CI: gosdk-resume-policy unit tests queued :gear:
auth-bot: Incident 2026-03-22T07:09Z: token-service restart caused generator session detaches; owner=pete
eva: metrics to add: gen.resume.policy_used, gen.resume.handshake_ms, gen.resume.outcome {attached,failed,conflict}. That will let us measure how much AutoAttach buys us in the wild.
pete: ok. Small API nit: prefer ResumePolicy named values on a typed option rather than magic booleans. Also expose Attach(ctx) as a convenience: Attach should do a single bounded handshake and return (Stream, ResumeFunc, error).
julia: I'll open the PR with: (A) sampleapp + README "ResumePolicy patterns", (B) SDK patch with ResumePolicy + Attach helper + ErrStreamDetached behind a beta flag, (C) unit tests and metrics. Pete/eva take owners on server idempotency + metrics.
pete: ack, will coordinate with infra to make Resume idempotent and add server reason codes.
eva: I'll add docs + migration note for channel-based streams vs Iterator.Next(ctx) pattern.
julia: thanks all. I'll post the PR link here when ready. :rocket:
